2026-09-19.title: 黑客利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 入侵 OpenAI 内部系统
2026-09-19.title_en: Hackers Used Anthropic's Claude to Break Into OpenAI

2026-09-19.title_en: Enhancing Program Integrity and Interagency Coordination in the Administration of the H-1B Nonimmigrant Visa Program
2026-09-19.title_zh: 特朗普签署行政令 收紧 H-1B 签证以保护美国本土劳工
2026-09-19.summary: ENHANCING PROGRAM INTEGRITY AND INTERAGENCY COORDINATION IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE H-1B NONIMMIGRANT VISA PROGRAM, September 18, 2026. By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered: Section 1. Purpose. The H-1B nonimmigrant visa program was created to identify uniquely skilled and highly specialized foreign temporary workers to strategically supplement the United States economy. Instead, the program has been widely abused by certain employers, third-party placement groups, and outsourcing firms to undercut and displace the supply of skilled United States labor.
2026-09-19.summary_en: ENHANCING PROGRAM INTEGRITY AND INTERAGENCY COORDINATION IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE H-1B NONIMMIGRANT VISA PROGRAM, September 18, 2026. By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered: Section 1. Purpose. The H-1B nonimmigrant visa program was created to identify uniquely skilled and highly specialized foreign temporary workers to strategically supplement the United States economy. Instead, the program has been widely abused by certain employers, third-party placement groups, and outsourcing firms to undercut and displace the supply of skilled United States labor.
2026-09-19.summary_zh: 白宫 9 月 18 日发布行政令，认定 H-1B 非移民签证项目被部分雇主、第三方派遣与外包公司“大规模系统性滥用”，用以压低薪酬、取代美国本土技术劳工，估计 H-1B 持有者薪酬较同等本土员工低 9,000 至 20,000 美元。行政令要求国务院、劳工部、国土安全部在审理劳工条件申请与签证时，与商务部、教育部及小企业管理局协商核查；并将“雇主在申请前一年内直接或间接裁员”列为审签考量因素。劳工部须在 30 日内启动对已提交申请的复查，判断是否需依《移民与国籍法》第 212(n)(2)(G) 条追责，同时将总统依第 215(a) 条的部分授权下放给上述四部门。此举将直接影响美国科技企业的技术人才引进与外包用工模式。

Secretary Rubio reiterated the importance of cooperating to secure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and also underscored the critical need for a fair, transparent, and equitable business environment for American companies operating in the Republic of Korea. He also emphasized the importance of securing supply chains for our critical industries.

2026-09-23.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，特朗普总统与丹麦首相弗雷泽里克森、格陵兰总理尼尔森共同签署协定，修订并补充1951年《格陵兰防务协议》，赋予美国对格陵兰安全利益的“永久控制权”与永久基地权，且不给美国纳税人增加成本。协定含排他条款：未经美方批准，任何美国对手不得在格陵兰建立基地、军事存在或进行敏感投资；同时确保格陵兰关键矿产不落入中国或俄罗斯之手。鲁比奥称，格陵兰将永久成为北美战略防御区的一部分，任何对手都将被排除在该地区及其周边之外；参议员麦考密克称该协定对美国“金色穹顶”防御体系具关键作用。特朗普称协定赋予美国对该领土安全及所有其他需求的永久控制权。丹麦外长拉斯穆森强调，协定充分尊重丹麦王国的主权和领土完整以及格陵兰人民的自决权。北约秘书长吕特、欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩、德国总理默茨、挪威首相斯特勒、意大利总理梅洛尼等多国政要表态支持。

2026-09-23.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，特朗普总统在第81届联合国大会发表演讲，宣称“美国回来了、比以往任何时候都更强大”，强调将以实力应对敌人、保护美国利益、禁止共产主义、拒绝全球控制并始终捍卫主权。他重申绝不允许伊朗拥有核武器，称伊朗为“头号恐怖主义支持者”；宣布美国不再允许任何威胁在西半球立足，必要时将动用“无与伦比的军事力量”维护美国核心利益；抨击古巴政权与美国国内左翼激进和共产主义网络勾连；称已把贩毒集团列为外国恐怖组织并动用军队打击，美军已对贩毒船只实施数十次打击、摧毁97%的海上毒品运输；强调“不存在全球政府、只要我在任就不会有全球税”。在人工智能议题上，他明确表示美国“完全拒绝任何为人工智能（下称‘超级智能’）构建全球主义控制方案的企图”。

2026-09-23.title_zh: 美国等15国发表《捍卫西半球主权联合声明》 启动“美洲之盾”三支柱
2026-09-23.summary: The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, and Trinidad and Tobago. We, the Heads of State and Government participating in the Shield of the Americas, jointly declare our intention to strengthen the resilience of the Western Hemisphere through three pillars: Economic, Security, and Multilateral Coordination, including exploring investment screening mechanisms, safeguarding critical minerals supply chains through diversified and reliable sourcing, and promoting trusted supplier regulations for digital infrastructure.
2026-09-23.summary_en: The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, and Trinidad and Tobago. We, the Heads of State and Government participating in the Shield of the Americas, jointly declare our intention to strengthen the resilience of the Western Hemisphere through three pillars: Economic, Security, and Multilateral Coordination, including exploring investment screening mechanisms, safeguarding critical minerals supply chains through diversified and reliable sourcing, and promoting trusted supplier regulations for digital infrastructure.
2026-09-23.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，美国、阿根廷、玻利维亚、智利、哥伦比亚、哥斯达黎加、多米尼加、厄瓜多尔、萨尔瓦多、圭亚那、洪都拉斯、巴拿马、巴拉圭、秘鲁、特立尼达和多巴哥15国政府发布《捍卫西半球主权联合声明》，宣布启动“美洲之盾”经济、安全与多边协调三大支柱。经济方面提出加强经济合作、探索投资审查机制、通过多元化可靠来源保障关键矿产供应链，并对数字基础设施推行“可信供应商”规则；安全方面协调制裁、认定与金融行动打击武装毒品恐怖网络，扩大民事执法；多边方面在各类多边场合捍卫国家主权与自决。声明同时宣布首个联合行动：对 MS-13、锡那罗亚集团、CJNG、 Tren de Aragua 等24个跨国有组织犯罪集团实施资产冻结、移民与签证限制及刑事责任追究，并拟联署请求美洲国家组织常设理事会召开磋商会议，依《里约条约》设立磋商机构、以部长级参与推动集体行动。

2026-09-24.title_zh: 美国与阿根廷启动"安第斯-大西洋走廊"
2026-09-24.summary: Today, U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau and Argentine Minister of Foreign Affairs Pablo Quirno launched the Andes-Atlantic Corridor, a joint initiative to strengthen and modernize infrastructure linking Argentina's vital economic sectors to major Atlantic ports and Western markets.
